meta.title: Guidelines for Test Frequency of various protection schemes & diagnostic testing of EHV equipment — Revision thereof

notes: Where ever specific limiting values & actions are not suggested, same should be decided in consultation with S.E., PAC.
Identification of Major/Important substations should be done by respective zonal Chief Engineer in consultation with S.E., PAC & S.E. EHV (O&M).
If required, separate teams out of existing Engineers & Staff be created for each EHV (O&M) Circle to carry out certain activities. Necessary training to these teams to be imparted by S.E., PACs.

Diagnostic measurement activities except DGA, Oil parameter test & Furan to be carried out departmentally. While efforts should be made to make extensive use of available Portable kit for DGA measurement.

rows.activity: Bushing – C & Tan δ (400 kV & 220 kV)
limits: Capacitance: −5% to +10%
Tan δ: 0.7%
Rate of rise of Tan δ: 0.1% per year (max)
In case Tan δ or Capacitance values exceed above limits, follow-up measurement should be carried out for next two quarters & replacement decision to be taken on the basis of rate of change observed.
However, if Tan δ value is more than 1.0% at any time, replacement of bushing to be done immediately.

rows.activity: Winding – C & Tan δ (400 kV & 220 kV)
limits: Measured values should be compared with factory test results or initial site commissioning values.

Any change in Capacitance of −5% to +10% or Tan δ more than 0.7%: further action to be decided in relation with Transformer test results & oil test results. This analysis of data & further action to be decided by S.E., TCC & S.E. EHV (O&M) jointly.

limits: Measured values should be compared with factory test results or initial site commissioning values.

Third Harmonic Resistive Current component — For new LA: up to 30 µA

limits: Capacitance: ±2%
Tan δ: 0.007 or +0.002 variation from factory test result or commissioning value.
In case Capacitance value exceeds above limit, follow-up measurement should be carried out yearly & replacement decision to be taken if value varies by ±6%.

In case Tan δ value exceeds above limit, follow-up measurement should be carried out yearly & replacement decision to be taken if value changes by +0.003 along with change in Capacitance & drift in secondary voltage.

errata.issue: Paper-moisture (Wp) limits were attached to Oil Parameter Test; in the circular they belong to DFR (Sr 14).
DFR had no limits in the old JSON; circular lists Wp moisture bands.
"Note change in capacitance & drift in secondary voltage" is a CVT (Sr 21) clause, not a CT clause. CT clause ends with "…rate of change observed & oil DGA results".
Clause 3 is about Capacitance (replace if varies by ±6%), not Tan δ.
PT row had CB contact-resistance limits copied in; circular gives no limits for PT.
Timing for EHV/HV breaker is done by O&M Team (old JSON said Testing Team).
Timing for HV breaker is O&M Team.
DCRM 220 kV major S/s: "During commissioning & then as and when required" — no "2 Yearly".
DCRM other EHV S/s is done by Testing Team, frequency as and when required.
Relay rows 34–38: revised frequency is "SOP as per Protection Manual"; clause 1 (thorough functional scheme testing) was missing.
Back-up relay is 2 Yearly by Testing Team (old JSON: Yearly, O&M).
Sr 39 is Battery Capacity Test (old JSON had it under Relays).
Battery Impedance: Yearly, no change (old JSON wrongly said revised to "as and when required").
Line Signature test is the row revised to "As & when required" (old JSON marked it unchanged).
Fault Locator: existing frequency is "Line Break Down" only.
